messages:
Maria: Putting the postmortem follow-ups for customer Pelion here. Root causes: intermittent VPC peering flaps, on-prem NAT churn, and an edge-proxy handshake race causing tenant isolation. Need owners and short timelines.

Priya: I can take peering hardening and MTU checks. Proposal: exponential backoff w/ full jitter + CB (5 failures, 60s window).

Dan: I'll own the edge-proxy race. I suspect KV warm timing; will try gating traffic until cache ready.

Alex: I'll do NAT visibility and conntrack alerts, plus a small dashboard widget for staleness metrics.

Maria: Thanks. Acceptance criteria: peering reconnects <2/hr over 7d, NAT stale <10s, isolation test in CI.

Priya: Creating ticket INC-PL-7001 for peering + MTU probe. Draft retry config in PR.

Dan: INC-PL-7002 for edge-proxy. Patch will add `kv_block_on_warm` and a 300ms passive delay. Will run a repro harness.

Alex: INC-PL-7003 for NAT visibility and dashboard. Will add alert if conntrack > 80% or NAT stale > 15s.

IncidentBot: [automation] Tickets created: INC-PL-7001, INC-PL-7002, INC-PL-7003.

Maria: Timeline: Priya staging deploy in 72h, Dan QA in 48h, Alex infra job running tomorrow. Coordinate a maintenance window with the customer before aggressive retries.

Priya: I'll loop in Pelion infra and propose two slots. Also adding graceful drain API to limit session bursts.

Dan: Patch posted to SCM: https://scm.redwood/PL-7002. Local tests pass; staging rollout next.

Alex: First infra job run scheduled for 03:30 UTC tomorrow, posting results to this thread.

Maria: Great. I'll update the postmortem doc with owners and these timelines. Reopen thread if blockers appear. :thumbsup:
